'''Green Squad''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore Republic]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. It was one of the [[Hitak Harriers]] reserve squads, and participated in an effort to capture the [[Hammer 4:3]] [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] during the [[Battle of Turak IV]] alongside [[Red Squad (Hitak Harriers)|Red Squad]] and [[Tech Team]].<ref name="Hammer" />
